item.title: 10 Years Ago, Anime's Most Bonkers Series Introduced a Disturbing Villain Who Changed Everything
item.description: Part 4 of JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure , called Diamond Is Unbreakable, also features an idyllic town with a rotten core. Author Hirohiko Araki changes things up after a globe-trotting adventure in Stardust Crusaders (Part 3), shifting the scene to the beautiful town of Morioh. Part 3 protagonist Jotaro Kujo seeks out Morioh resident Josuke Higashikata seeking to learn more about his true parentage, which triggers a string of bizarre events in this seemingly peaceful small town.

item.title: Free-to-Play Pokémon Game Is Shutting Down After 5 Years
item.description: Pokémon games come in all shapes and forms. There are the mainline Pokémon games, where players must collect 'em all and engage in battle with other trainers. But these pocket monsters have appeared in other video game genres as part of several series spin-offs. For example, Pokémon Unite is a MOBA similar to League of Legends but with Pokémon. The concept is fun, and the fact that it's free-to-play caught the attention of many. Unfortunately, its servers will soon shut down permanently.

item.title: 7 Reasons FF7 Is the Ultimate Video Game Fairy Tale
item.description: When you think of a fairy tale, what comes to mind? A medieval European setting, with soaring castle spires, imposing forests, brave knights, and fair maidens?

item.title: These Two Dark Fairytales Need to Unravel on Modern Consoles
item.description: The world can be a cold and dangerous place. We think about its darkest parts as we wrap ourselves in blankets and find a comfy armchair near a roaring fireplace, much like our ancestors did. Also like our ancestors, we turn to stories to understand how to survive the darkness: Don’t trust tricksters with magical powers, avoid suspicious fruit, and never venture into the woods alone.

item.title: Wildwood channels The Decemberists' folk fairytale legacy
item.description: “I feel like when we were first coming up with the story, we were trying to really go for the early stuff — pull from folktale and fair ytale tropes,” Meloy tells Polygon. “I think there’s so many things in the movie that, because that was really the intent from the outset, was to create a fairy tale. Inevitably, it ends up like fantasy in the context of 2026, but that’s what we were shooting for.”

item.title: Godzilla Minus Zero Director's Upcoming Giant Robot Movie First Cast Members Revealed
item.description: Takashi Yamazaki's Godzilla Minus Zero is not out in cinemas yet, but fans of the Japanese director already have another movie to look forward to. Grandgear , a mech action movie and the director's first English-language production, was announced in 2024, and the first cast members have just been revealed.

item.title: 9 Spooky 'Far Side' Comics That Are Perfect to Read Before Halloween
item.description: During this time of year, all the classic monsters enjoy their annual resurgence. Vampires rise from their coffins, mummies emerge from their tombs, and witches fly in on their brooms to stalk the world of the living via decorations and costumes. Many people also enjoy horror marathons of the old Universal monster movies. Given the spirit of the season, I’ve decided to dig around for nine great Far Side comic strips featuring classic monsters.

item.title: 8 Most Entertaining Sci-Fi Books of the 21st Century That Are Impossible to Put Down
item.description: Science fiction writers imagine humanity's future in order to explore our present and past. The best sci-fi is a mix of cautionary tale and social commentary, but books about heady topics like artificial intelligence, alien encounters, and galaxy-spanning wars are often filled with dense explanations of theoretical technologies or complex political factions. It doesn't have to be that way. While dry and heavy sci-fi can be extremely rewarding to read, the genre also offers plenty of lighter options filled with humor and adventure. If you want some laughs in your future, check out these eight extremely fun sci-fi books that grapple with modern issues facing humanity in the 21st Century.
